description: This source file defines the LogExtent class and associated nested classes, used for representing and enumerating over sealed log segments with buffering and serialization support in the Orleans.Journaling namespace.

classes.name: LogExtent
classes.description: Represents a sealed and immutable log segment with buffer management and enumeration capabilities.

classes.name: LogExtent.Entry
classes.description: A record struct representing an entry in the log, consisting of a stream ID and payload.

classes.name: LogExtent.EntryEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerator for iterating over entries within a LogExtent.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next log entry, interpreting the buffer data.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator instance for iteration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an EntryEnumerator for a given LogExtent.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the enumerator to its initial state.
